notes.title: New Intro Video Added to Square City Builder!
notes.notes:
Update Notes – Intro Video Added

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Quy7Ovg.gif[/img]

    [list]
[*] Added a new intro video that plays at the start of the game.
[*] The video introduces the game world and sets the tone before entering the main menu.
[*]  Option to skip the intro video is available with any key press.
[*]     Minor optimizations related to video playback and scene transition timing.
[/list]

This update aims to improve the first-time player experience and give more context to the city-building environment.

More improvements and content updates are coming soon. Thank you for playing Square City Builder!

notes.title: Fixed: Mouse Cursor No Longer Disappears Off-Screen
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First of all, thank you so much for playing Square City Builder!
Your support means the world to us, and we're always looking to make the game better.
If you have any suggestions, ideas, or run into any issues, feel free to leave your feedback — we’re listening!

[previewyoutube=ZMmJQ4yTiA0;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve also fixed an issue where the mouse cursor could move outside the game window during gameplay.
The cursor is now correctly confined within the game boundaries in both windowed mode and fullscreen mode, ensuring a smoother and more consistent experience when interacting with the UI or performing actions that rely on the mouse.

Thanks again, and happy building!

notes.title: 🖱️ Bugfix: Mouse Issue Resolved
notes.notes:
We’ve fixed a bug that was causing unexpected mouse behavior. The mouse speed should now feel much more normal and work correctly on most hardware setups.
Thanks for your patience and all the reports — let us know if you run into anything else!

notes.title: Bug Fix: Mouse Position Issue Resolved!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rKpOnWx.png[/img]

We've just released a small but important update to address an issue where some players experienced problems with the mouse cursor moving out of the screen, making it difficult to play. This issue has now been fixed in the latest version!

If you encounter any further issues or have feedback, feel free to share your thoughts in the community. Your support and input help us improve the game!

Thank you, and happy building!

notes.title: features fixed and translations added
notes.notes:
A new update for Square City Builder is now available, focusing on improving localization and fixing some reported issues.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5Z4MNuN.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added translations for buttons like Load and Delete, making navigation easier for players in different languages.
[*] Adjusted mouse speed to ensure a more consistent experience.
[*] The Delete Save function now works correctly without requiring a game restart.
[/list]


[h3]Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Let us know if you encounter any other issues.[/h3]

notes.title: New Start Screen
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z8Ni0mv.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce an update that enhances our game’s starter screen, aligning it with the consistent look and feel of our entire franchise. This improvement not only streamlines your initial experience but also ensures a more unified and polished interface across our titles.

Your feedback is incredibly important to us. Please share your thoughts on the new design and let us know how it feels compared to previous versions. We’re committed to continuous improvement, and more exciting updates are on the way.

Thank you for your support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Delete saves added!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that despite the long wait, we’re now committed to releasing updates frequently! In our latest update, we’ve added a highly requested feature that allows you to delete saves, along with several bug fixes to enhance your gameplay experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p4xzvwJ.png[/img]

We truly appreciate your feedback, so please let us know what you think and stay tuned for more updates coming soon. Thanks for your continued support and for being part of our community!

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0
notes.notes:
We’re here with a new update that includes a few tweaks to improve gameplay experience and fix an important issue. The biggest change in this update was the fix for a Steamworks bug that had stopped working in recent versions. This issue has now been resolved, and Steamworks is back to working as expected!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZJRCjJX.jpeg[/img]
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Small gameplay tweaks to enhance experience.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused Steamworks to malfunction in recent versions. Everything is now working as expected!
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. Enjoy the updates!

[/list]
